package handler

import (
	"example.com/remote-test/game/requests"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/infra/base/fctx"
)

//roost:nest durability=memory
func handlerQuery(p entity.IThreadSafeEntity, req requests.Query) (int64, error) {
	if !fctx.InShortWorker() {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("handler outside short worker")
	}
	v := req.MustAlliance()
	if req.Done != nil {
		req.Done <- v.Bonus
	}
	return v.Bonus, nil
}

//roost:nest durability=memory
func handlerOptional(p entity.IThreadSafeEntity, req *requests.Optional) (bool, error) {
	_, ok := req.Alliance()
	return ok, nil
}

//roost:nest durability=memory
func handlerPing(p entity.IThreadSafeEntity) (int64, error) { return p.ID(), nil }
